sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2021 Audi RS6 Avant, finished in Nardo Gray with a black interior. The odometer on this RS6 currently displays approximately 23,700 miles. This Audi is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report, and it shows this wagon has reportedly been registered to one owner in California since new. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Executive, Black Optic, and Driver Assistance packages, and 22-inch wheels. Notable modifications reported by the seller include an Alcantara-trimmed steering wheel, Auto Parking and Auto-Hold functions, and Euro-spec carbon fiber center console trim. After an outcry from dedicated Audi enthusiasts, the manufacturer decided to bring the wagon version of its vaunted RS6 to the U.S. for the first time during the 2020 model year. It received nearly instant critical acclaim for its aggressive styling, everyday practicality, and outstanding performance. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V8, rated at 591 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission.
sections.Equipment: A window sticker is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes: Executive Package Black Optic Package Driver Assistance Package 22-inch wheels Sport exhaust Air suspension Head-up display Bang & Olufsen Sound system
sections.Seller Notes: This RS6 is offered with a transferable warranty valid until May 2031 or 100,000 miles, and a tire and wheel protection package valid until May 2027. Documentation regarding the service contract is pictured in the photo gallery. The seller reports that paint protection film has been applied to the entire exterior. The tires on this RS6 carry 2023 date codes.
